fusions.name: Bristle Spray
fusions.desc: Looses 5 iron bristles at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage, with a 20% chance to leave the target [Sundered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Garrotte Wire
fusions.desc: Loops an iron wire around a wounded enemy's throat, dealing 22 damage, consuming every affliction on it to add 1.2 times their remaining damage, and leaving it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Wire Snarl
fusions.desc: Strings a 5-tile tangle of iron wire ahead of you for 8 seconds. It blocks enemies, and anything that touches it moves 25% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Thousandfold Weave
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 8%, and you have 12% slashing resistance.
